# Lori McNee

> A landscape painter's resource for plein air painting workshops, techniques, and artistic development in the American West.

Lori McNee is a professional landscape painter offering immersive workshops and sharing expert guidance on plein air painting, color theory, and artistic practice. The site features both instructional workshops and reflective essays on painting techniques and the creative process.

## Key Topics

- Plein air painting
- Landscape painting
- Lori McNee
- Sun Valley, Idaho
- Painting techniques
- Color and contrast
- Artist development
- Workshop instruction
- Painting series
- Cold-weather painting
- Small paintings
- Autumn landscapes
- Montana
- The American West
- Memory and painting

## Workshops & Events

- [Plein Air Painting Workshop with Lori McNee in Sun Valley, Idaho](https://lorimcnee.com/plein-air-painting-workshop-with-lori-mcnee-in-sun-valley-idaho): Two-day plein air painting workshop with Lori McNee in Sun Valley, Idaho
- [Wild Women Paint the West in Montana](https://lorimcnee.com/wild-women-paint-the-west-in-montana): Wild Women Paint the West exhibition in Philipsburg, Montana featuring eight artists

## Painting Techniques & Instruction

- [3 Ways to Make Autumn Colors Pop in Your Paintings](https://lorimcnee.com/3-ways-to-make-autumn-colors-pop-in-your-paintings): Techniques for using contrast, value, and edges in autumn landscape paintings
- [Winter Plein Air Painting: My Cold-Weather Secrets](https://lorimcnee.com/winter-plein-air-painting-cold-weather-secrets): Cold-weather techniques for staying warm and inspired during winter plein air
- [Small Paintings: Nowhere to Hide](https://lorimcnee.com/small-paintings-nowhere-to-hide): Guide on why small paintings challenge artists and strengthen painting skills

## Artist Development & Practice

- [Why Professional Artists Paint in Series](https://lorimcnee.com/why-professionals-paint-in-series): Insights on how painting in series elevates art and reveals authentic voice
- [Are You a Resolutionist? Gentler Artist Goals to Start the New Year](https://lorimcnee.com/are-you-a-resolutionist-gentler-artist-goals-to-start-the-new-year): Tips for setting realistic, gentle creative goals for the new year
- [How AI Helped Me Shape a Memory into a Painting](https://lorimcnee.com/how-ai-helped-me-shape-a-memory-into-a-painting): Lori McNee's process using AI to transform memories into paintings
